ReleaseNotes: SnipEX Aura 1.0.10: the installer now replaces the stable SnipEx client and earlier SnipEX Aura builds (user data is kept), smooth snow on PCs where the Windows timer made it choppy, an updater that works through office proxies and explains failures, the WORKSPACE snow ledge on a cold start, and birds/aurora that show up sooner. Per-user installation needs no administrator elevation. This release is unsigned.
